components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, #E5E2DC); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #E5E2DC); padding: 18px 12px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #111827); transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-ledger-row:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #F2EFE9); } .ds-ledger-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4285F4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ledger-date { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-muted, #4B5563); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-ledger-title { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-ledger-sub { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-muted, #4B5563); } .ds-ledger-badge { border: 1px solid rgba(234, 67, 53, 0.35); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(234, 67, 53, 0.12); color: #B91C1C; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Track Filter Pill
components.description: Capsule toggle for track and vertical filtering with WCAG AA yellow-on-dark-ink compliance.
components.css: .ds-pill-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #E5E2DC); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--canvas, #FAF9F6); color: var(--ink-muted, #4B5563); padding: 8px 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4285F4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill-active { border-color: var(--ink, #111827); background: var(--ink, #111827); color: var(--canvas, #FAF9F6); } .ds-pill-yellow { border-color: rgba(217, 155, 0, 0.45); background: rgba(251, 188, 4, 0.22); color: #111827; } .ds-dot-ink { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #111827; }

narrative.overview: The GDG on Campus RV College of Engineering web interface is designed like an open-spine, interactive engineering almanac rather than a boxed SaaS template. Full-bleed studio paper in Light mode (#FAF9F6) and deep carbon-slate in Dark mode (#0C0F14) stay open and breathable, partitioned by crisp 1px full-width architectural hairlines (--hairline), asymmetric two-column splits, and dramatic Plus Jakarta Sans typographic hierarchy—never repetitive grids of rounded cards. Every interaction earns its existence through genuine developer utility: a global ⌘K command palette for instant cross-route navigation, an interactive Google-track architecture and pure CSS 3D geometry playground on /, a Grid-versus-Compact-Ledger view switcher on /events, client-side .ics calendar export and expandable speaker syllabi on /events/[slug], and expressive custom SVG builder portraits with a slide-over Builder Dossier on /team.
keyCharacteristics: Unboxed editorial spreads separated by full-width 1px --hairline rules across #FAF9F6 (Light) and #0C0F14 (Dark) toggled via Tailwind CSS v4 @custom-variant dark.

Dramatic Plus Jakarta Sans display scale paired with strictly functional JetBrains Mono for code/architecture snippets, tabular-nums schedules and countdowns, keyboard shortcuts (⌘K), and technical prerequisites.
Disciplined Google four-color wayfinding (Blue for Web & primary action, Green for AI/ML & Live status, Red for Cloud & campus venues, Yellow with #111827 dark ink for Android/Design).

Pure CSS 3D geometry (perspective, transform-style: preserve-3d) and hand-authored SVG developer portraits animating strictly GPU-composited transform and opacity with full prefers-reduced-motion: reduce halts.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Never place white text on Google Yellow (#FBBC04 or #FDD663). Every yellow badge or highlight surface pairs strictly with #111827 dark ink in Light mode (>= 10.3:1) and translucent #FDD663/18 with #FDD663 ink on dark carbon in Dark mode.

rules.name: The Split-Blue Contrast Rule
rules.body: Reserve pure #4285F4 for brand marks, focus outlines, borders, and 3D wireframes; always use --gdg-blue-ink (#1765CC Light / #669DF6 Dark) for small interactive blue copy and #1A73E8 for white-text primary buttons.

rules.name: The Unboxed Field Rule
rules.body: Use color as leading dots, crisp taxonomy badges, interactive state indicators, and wireframe/portrait geometry—never colored top-stripe bars or decorative background gradients.

rules.name: The Zero-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never place uppercase monospace kickers or 01 //, 02 //, 03 // index numbers above headings. Let generous whitespace (>= 48px above a heading vs. 12px–16px below) and clear typographic scale establish hierarchy on their own.

rules.name: The Earned-Monospace Rule
rules.body: Restrict JetBrains Mono to genuine data, dates, code snippets, handles, shortcuts, and tabular counters—never as decorative styling for headings or editorial paragraphs.

rules.name: The Zero-Nesting Rule
rules.body: Never place a bordered rounded card inside another bordered rounded card. Use hairline dividers (border-t border-hairline) or direct open placement on --canvas.

rules.name: The GPU-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Every continuous animation and interactive transition animates only transform, opacity, or instant color/border shifts—never width, height, top, left, box-shadow, or blur.

dos: Do structure sections with open --canvas, generous whitespace, asymmetric two-column splits, and full-width 1px --hairline dividers.
Do pair Google Yellow (#FBBC04 / #FDD663) light-mode surfaces strictly with #111827 dark ink and use --gdg-blue-ink (#1765CC Light / #669DF6 Dark) for small blue interactive text.

Do keep focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[#4285F4] on every interactive control and guard client-dependent UI (ThemeToggle, CountdownTimer) with useSyncExternalStore for zero hydration warnings.
Do preserve p-2 clear space and exact aspect ratio around <GdgLogo />, open-source credits, and the non-Google-product footer disclaimer.
Do keep every 3D animation strictly GPU-composited (transform, opacity) and cleanly disabled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
donts: Don't build stacked uniform grids of icon + heading + paragraph cards (PillarsGrid boxes, 10 identical MemberCard boxes, or 5 identical social cards).
Don't place uppercase monospace eyebrow labels or section numbers (01 //, 02 //, 03 //) above headings.
Don't add colored top-stripe borders (border-t-2 / h-1 color bars) on cards or nest cards inside cards.
Don't place white text on Google Yellow (#FBBC04 / #FDD663) anywhere.

Don't import heavy 3D/animation libraries (three, @react-three/fiber, spline, lottie-web, framer-motion), or add analytics, RSVP/interest counters, attendee lists, comments, live chat, real student PII, or forbidden routes (/about, /resources, /faq, /join, /contact, /api/*).
